_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Product Base Line Index (PBLI)
summary: A Product Base Line Index (PBLI) is a current listing of documentation comprising the authorized configuration identification of an equipment/system being procured, used by the contracting activity for review and evaluation.
description_purpose: A Product Base Line Index (PBLI) is a current listing of documentation which comprises the authorized configuration identification of an equipment/system being procured. The principal use is to provide the contracting activity a basis for review and evaluation of the equipment/system being procured.
application_interrelationship: This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirements as delineated in the contract.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The PBLI shall be in the contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The Product Base Line Index shall include a cover page that specifies the following: Government-assigned nomenclature; Title of the Document, i.e., Product Base Line Index; Prepared by (preparing company's name); Prepared for (Procuring Activity); Government contract number(s); Identification number of the document; Revision letter of the document and/or date of revision; Page 1 of ___ (last page number). Applicable number shall appear on each page of the PBLI.

children.title: The list of effective pages shall be identified and include page numbers and the revision letter of each page.
The PBLI shall contain a table of contents.
children.content: It shall identify the section number, title and first page number of each section.

children.title: The PBLI shall contain an introduction which includes a description of the purpose and an organization of contents.
The PBLI shall include a listing of the contractor provided data associated with the equipment/system.
children.content: The authorized configuration of this data shall be defined by the documents identified in the Product Base Line Index. Each item of contractor provided data identified in this listing shall include the document number, the latest authorized document revision and the document title.

preparation_instructions.title: Military specifications.
preparation_instructions.content: This section shall include a listing of military specifications which define the authorized configuration of the equipment/system. Each entry shall include the revision letter, date and title of the specification.

preparation_instructions.title: Contractor specifications.
preparation_instructions.content: This section shall include a listing of contractor specifications which define the authorized configuration of the equipment/system. Each entry shall include the document number, revision letter and title of the specification.

preparation_instructions.title: Government furnished information.
preparation_instructions.content: This section shall include a listing of government furnished information which define the authorized configuration of the equipment/system. Each entry shall include the document number, revision letter, approved Engineering Change Proposals and the title of the document.

preparation_instructions.title: Technical manuals.
preparation_instructions.content: This section shall include a listing of technical manuals which define the authorized configuration of the equipment/system. Each entry shall include the government number, contractors name/number, revision level, revision date and title of the document.

preparation_instructions.title: Contractor drawings.
preparation_instructions.content: This section shall include a listing of contractor drawings which define the authorized configuration of the equipment/system. Each entry shall include the document number, revision letter, approved Engineering Orders and the title of the document.
